title: Puzzle2d Zoom Performance
description: Fix 15s+ zoom from small to big in puzzle 2d play
summary:
Zoom small→big was ~15s because each wheel frame repainted all text overlays, WASM rebuilt world_content_cache on every LOD band crossing, and setEffectiveLodForPane triggered runtime.notify() (full shell rebuild).

Fixes: skip paintTextOverlays during wheelZoomGestureActive + invalidate once at gesture end; pin draw LOD in WASM for wheel gestures; cache edges in world_content_cache; setEffectiveLodForPane uses notifyChrome only.

Tests: puzzle/2d/react 109, puzzle/2d/play 8.
